maya: Hey — PR #8142 is red but only the integration job `integration/checkout-flow` failed. Can we rerun just that job without rebuilding the docker image?

omar: Yep. If the run id is available you can use our small wrapper to avoid image rebuilds: 
```
./scripts/ci rerun --run-id 123456 --job integration/checkout-flow --no-image
```
That keeps the same image and mounts cache volumes.

maya: Nice, where do I find the run id?

ci-bot: Run id printed on the workflow header: `Run #123456` (link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/actions/runs/123456). Job name exactly: `integration/checkout-flow`.

sam: If you don't want to use the wrapper, you can also comment on the PR with the command we listen for: 
`/rerun job integration/checkout-flow --no-image`
CI bot will queue it and echo the job id.

maya: tried the PR comment — bot queued it but said "image rebuild required". Any idea why?

omar: That usually happens if the job's matrix changed or the cached image tag is stale. Check the run comparison: if the matrix or commit changed we force an image rebuild. If it's the same commit, try specifying `--preserve-image` instead of `--no-image` in the wrapper.

alex: Also check if the test touches infra that needs a fresh worker (e.g., devstack migrations). If it's purely flaky, you can target the single test instead: 
```
./scripts/ci rerun-test --run-id 123456 --test "flaky::TestCheckoutTimeout::test_times_out" --preserve-worker
```
This reruns only that test on the same worker where possible.

maya: Good call — it's a timeout in TestCheckoutTimeout. I'll try `rerun-test` first.

ci-bot: FYI: rerun-test can fail if the original worker no longer exists; in that case the wrapper falls back to rerunning the whole job and will log `worker-not-found`.

sam: If this is recurring, we should bisect to find the commit that introduced the flake: 
```
./scripts/ci bisect --pr 8142 --job integration/checkout-flow --tests "flaky::TestCheckoutTimeout" --start 200 --end 220
```
It will queue a sequence of runs and report the first bad commit.

maya: Thanks — trying `rerun-test` now. If that fails I'll post the run id here and ping infra for a bisect. :thumbsup: 

omar: Ping me if the bot complains about images, I can manually resubmit a preserved-image rerun.

maya: Done — rerun started, bot says `rerun-task-998` queued. Will update with results.

alex: Awesome. If it passes, we should mark the test in the flaky registry and add a short timeout bump as a temporary mitigation.

maya: Will do.
